zh-CN.title: 《五经正义》通行整理本
zh-CN.subtitle: 经学注疏的版本层入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 版本层把《五经正义》的具体整理本、卷次和引文定位从文本总条目中分离出来。
curatorialDescription: 后续段落引用必须回到明确版本，不能只引用“《五经正义》”这一总称。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充整理者、卷次、底本、页码和引文标准。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 现代整理本；对应唐代经学文本

en.title: Received edited version of the Corrected Meanings
en.subtitle: A version-layer entry for classical commentary
en.shortSummary: The version layer separates the specific edited text, fascicles and citation locator from the general text record.
curatorialDescription: Future passage citations must point to an explicit version rather than only naming the Corrected Meanings in general.
en.researchNote: Editor, fascicles, base text, pages and citation standard still need to be added.
en.timeLabel: Modern edited version; corresponding to Tang classical commentary
